propositions: No standing instrument exists to measure whether changes to plan-review criteria, questions, or thresholds improve or regress gate quality before shipping.
A frozen replay corpus with reconstructed plan text and outcome labels exists but requires a unified harness to enable tiered offline evaluation.
The harness must enforce a hard $200 Bedrock budget, model parity (Opus for Pass-1, Sonnet for Pass-2), and refuse runs that would exceed remaining allocation.

Tier-2 single-criterion evaluation produces degenerate signatures (Mean Jaccard 0.0) across multiple 20-sample runs even after fixing a repo_root/tickets_root conflation bug affecting code-grounded criteria.
Prompt caching has been 0% active since 2026-08-12 due to mixed Bedrock+Anthropic provider chain disabling cache, reducing cost efficiency from $2.18 to $4.82 per uncached review.
The harness must record per-pass model ids, refuse to diff results with differing model ids, and validate that all Bedrock calls use the production model class.
